# Calls of `cellsurface_sorting_hat` (v1)

*Generated by `analysis/class_table/make_classes_md.py` from `docs/class_descriptions.yaml` and `src/cellsurface_sorting_hat/categories.yaml`. Do not edit by hand; a test checks that this file is current.*

Evidence calls say what a tool found. Composites (`_candidate`) say what a rule combined. `other_*` calls are the residual categories.
A status holds for one species and taxon and only where its status file is installed and current:
`unvalidated` (no measurement), `smoke` (too little truth for a number), `estimated` (enough truth).

| call | kind | gated | category | meaning | reads | status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `signal_peptide_protein` | evidence | yes | surface glycoprotein | SignalP 6 predicts a signal peptide (rule R0). Nothing more is claimed. | step1_rule@R0 | estimated in A. nidulans (taxon 162425); smoke in taxa 4932, 5476, 746128, 5207 and 5270; unvalidated elsewhere. The status files are in git-ignored work directories; the report is cited. |
| `tandem_repeat_protein` | evidence | no | cell wall and adhesion | One of two period detectors finds a tandem array (period above 0, coverage 0.25 or more, 2.5 copies or more). It also fires for intracellular repeat proteins. | repeat02, repeat14 | smoke where the call file is current: S288C sensitivity 0.435 [0.067, 0.667], specificity 0.987; C. albicans 0.462 [0.000, 0.788], 0.976. ## Modules that no call reads (evidence fields or experimental)

- `tm`: TMHMM; a condition for CFEM (no mature TM helix) and an evidence field.
- `cys_rich`: Cysteine-rich tiers (Coccidioides RS only); evidence field.
- `expression`: Spherule expression lookup (Coccidioides only); evidence field.
- `cys8_pattern`: Eight-cysteine spacing plus R0; experimental, read by no call.
- `hydrophobin_relaxed`: Relaxed hydrophobin level; experimental, read by no call (owner decision 2026-10-08, strict call only).
